{{Quote|You never know what you'll find on the junk heap of a planet that is Raxus Prime, and this slider's no different. Made with whatever leftovers we've got back in the kitchen, this slider is a surprise every time it's ordered!|Dex's Diner menu, on the Raxus slider|<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />}}
'''Raxus sliders''' were one of the speciality [[slider]]s offered at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The slider was inspired by the junk planet [[Raxus Prime]] and was made from the diner's [[Foodstuff/Legends|leftovers]]. It cost 6.7 [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> While trapped in a [[Kharys' fortress|fortress]] on the planet [[Skye]]<ref name="SkyeWalkers">''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''</ref> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="SkyeWalkers Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the hungry [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Halagad Ventor]] mentioned the Raxus slider as a way to encourage the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakine Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to move faster.<ref name="SkyeWalkers" />

==Behind the scenes==
Raxus sliders were first mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
